cues.text: You and Aigis come down the steps outside Iwatodai Station when two dogs, one of them a black Shiba Inu, and a brown cat run up and plant themselves in your way.
Aigis steps toward the animals, and the black Shiba Inu lunges and bites her hand.
The two dogs and the cat turn and run off.
Aigis turns and walks away, leaving you alone at the station.
